function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content: Shashi Tej Reddy (born 1955) is an Indian politician and former Minister of State for Finance. He represented the Nalgonda constituency in the Lok Sabha and was a member of the Indian National Congress. Reddy served as Minister of State for Finance in the Ministry of Finance during the Manmohan Singh administration (2009‑2012). He has also been active in business and regional politics in Telangana.
